name: zfmv_script_update
description: zFMV_Script::Update advances the current FMV action by relative time, keeps active actions, ends completed actions, and begins the next action at the same relative time.
known_limits: VC5SP3 zfmv_script_cleanup_reset coverage exists; after recovering zInput::PollActiveDevices as a byte dispatch flag ABI, zFMV_Script::Update has zero unmasked function-byte mismatches after relocation masking.
Source dependencies are accepted; zInput::Keyboard_WaitForAnyKeyPress is tier B/data accepted and zInput::PollActiveDevices is tier S.
